versions.name: Missouri River High Adventure Base

features.note: A 60-mile crew-led canoe trek down the Missouri River.
Built for older Scouts and high-adventure crews; no merit badge schedule.

versions.summary: High-adventure base offering a 60-mile canoe trek along the Missouri River, operated by Sioux Council in South Dakota.

sources.citation: Community correction via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by council staff 2026-08-13 (submission bZ6VdDE); submitter requested credit but provided only an email, which is withheld. The base is located at and run from Lewis and Clark Scout Ranch, 31071 430th Ave, Tabor SD 57063; the prior coordinates were a state-centroid approximation. Coordinates cleared pending re-geocoding from the corrected address.
Coordinate geocoded 2026-08-14 from the corrected street address via the US Census geocoder; elevation from the open-meteo DEM. July normals still pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). This is a trek base rather than a facility camp: the page states it has no cabins and no merit badge program, so the short feature list is the property, not a gap in sourcing. Council repointed 2026-07-26: Black Hills Area Council was absorbed by Sioux Council (recorded in data/councils/_events.json); the camp had been left on the dissolved council, which resolves as a ref but is not current.
